title: SceneBloom: Agentic Indoor Environment Generation with Realistic and Diverse Layouts for Embodied Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.32978v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training generalizable embodied agents requires realistic, varied, and simulation-ready indoor environments. Language-guided methods support semantic planning and object-level reasoning, but precise spatial grounding remains difficult. Visual generative models offer rich priors over plausible arrangements, yet their outputs require geometric reasoning to become physically valid 3D scenes. We introduce SceneBloom, an agentic framework that combines visual layout sampling with contract-guided 3D compilation. A hierarchical sampler uses diffusion priors to generate furniture arrangements within functional zones. A compiler then uses relations extracted from each proposal to guide geometric fitting and local pose correction. Across five room types, SceneBloom attains the highest visual quality and physical stability among the compared methods and is the only method with no detected mesh collisions and out-of-bounds objects. translated_title: SceneBloom：面向具身学习的具有真实且多样化布局的智能体化室内环境生成
translated_abstract: 训练可泛化的具身智能体需要真实、多样且可直接用于仿真的室内环境。语言引导的方法支持语义规划与对象级推理，但精确的空间定位仍然困难。视觉生成模型对合理的布局拥有丰富的先验，但其输出需要几何推理才能转化为物理上有效的3D场景。我们提出SceneBloom，一个将视觉布局采样与契约引导的3D编译相结合的智能体框架。分层采样器利用扩散先验在功能区域内生成家具布置，编译器随后利用从每个方案中提取的空间关系来指导几何适配与局部姿态校正。在五种房间类型上，SceneBloom在所比较的方法中取得了最高的视觉质量与物理稳定性，并且是唯一未检测到网格碰撞与越界物体的方法。
tldr: SceneBloom是一个结合视觉布局采样与契约引导3D编译的智能体框架，利用扩散先验在功能区域内生成家具布局并通过几何适配与姿态校正实现物理有效的室内场景，在五种房间类型上取得了最高的视觉质量与物理稳定性，且是唯一无网格碰撞与越界物体的方法。
en_tdlr: SceneBloom is an agentic framework that combines diffusion-prior-based visual layout sampling with contract-guided 3D compilation, achieving the highest visual quality and physical stability across five room types while being the only method with no detected mesh collisions or out-of-bounds objects.
